request.spec:
Show on each person their cut total: their cuts across every pool they are a member of, added
up (a pool that shows no cuts adds nothing). Show the sheet's cut total: everyone's added up.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their cut total: their cuts across every pool they are a member of, added
up (a pool that shows no cuts adds nothing). Show the sheet's cut total: everyone's added up.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person now shows their cut total and the sheet shows its overall cut total. All 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

The change is one new front-end file, `src/main/frontend/features/pools/cuttotal.slot.tsx`. Nothing changed on the server or in the stored data, because the pools response already includes each member's cut.

- **Per person (`person-cut-total`):** a "Cut total" column in the people table. It adds up that person's cuts in every pool they belong to. A pool with no cuts adds nothing; that's a pool that isn't balanced or has no pot, whose cut shows as blank.
- **Sheet total (`rollup-cut-total`):** a "Cut in total" line just below "Claimed in total". It adds up every person's cuts.

The sums are worked out in whole cents so they come out exact. A pool that is itself a member of another pool only passes its cut down to its own members; it isn't counted as a person, so nothing is counted twice.
